articles.title: US Attacks Iran Again! American Strike Hits Konarak Naval Base, Wounds 2 Iranian Soldiers
articles.description: Iran says American forces have carried out a fresh strike on its territory, targeting the Konarak naval base on the country’s southeastern coast and wounding two Iranian servicemen. According to Iran’s Navy, the US military used “two light projectiles” against the facility in Sistan and Baluchestan province, targeting a 35mm naval cannon. The Iranian account indicates the immediate damage was limited, but the location gives the incident wider significance. Konarak sits near Chabahar on the Gulf of Oman, east of the Strait of Hormuz. Iran recently announced an expanded naval deployment posture stretching from Hormuz into the Gulf of Oman and Arabian Sea, while warning that it intends to push American naval forces farther from its coastline. Tehran has also repeatedly warned that renewed US attacks could trigger retaliation against American forces and interests across the region. Iran’s account therefore puts renewed attention on whether and how Tehran responds to the reported strike.#iran #unitedstates #konarak #usiran #iranNavy #centcom #hormuz #gulfofoman #tehran #usmilitary

articles.title: 'France Humiliated': Macron DEFIED, Rioting Sweeps Paris For 2nd Night; Luxury Stores LOOTED | WATCH
articles.description: Riots continue across France for the second consecutive night even as President Macron vowed to crush the violent agitators amid unprecedented looting and arson across the country. Riot police fired tear gas, chased demonstrators through the streets and made arrests, while looting, fires and vandalism continued after one of France’s most turbulent weekends in years. Paris city workers were still clearing burned-out cars, shattered storefronts and charred debris from Saturday's unrest when fresh clashes erupted, and the political blame game intensified. Footage showed protesters throwing stones and debris at officers, blocking roads with burning rubbish and damaging shops. Police responded with tear gas and batons, while officers on motorbikes patrolled commercial districts and guarded damaged businesses.

articles.title: ON CAM: Macron Addresses France Protests After Elysee Palace Attacked
articles.description: French President Emmanuel Macron has announced a sweeping crackdown after violent unrest erupted across multiple French cities, with shops looted, public buildings attacked and hundreds of police and gendarmes injured. In a national address, Macron said France felt both “anger” and “shame” over the destruction and warned that those responsible would face consequences. He declared that “those who destroyed must pay,” those who looted must reimburse, and those who tried to bring down the Republic would have to answer for it. Macron also said authorities could go as far as banning certain gatherings where necessary and promised a hard line against rioters, saying: “We will be uncompromising.”
